subject: Use when working with Shopify — Admin API, Storefront API, OAuth scopes, HMAC SHA-256 webhook verification, GraphQL…

evals.prompt: Define shopify in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the shopify skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind shopify. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "Design the event payload schema for our internal order-processing pipeline". Should shopify activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force shopify onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to webhook-integration, event-contract-design, api-design, printify.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "Verify an incoming Shopify webhook by computing HMAC SHA-256 over the raw body and comparing against the X-Shopify-Hmac-Sha256 header". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying shopify.
Place shopify among its adjacent skills (webhook-integration, event-contract-design, api-design, printify). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.

evals.prompt: Name one plausible misconception about shopify and correct it with a mechanism-level explanation.
